51523928.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to Escherichia coli TrmD by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: The TrmD enzyme was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (GE Healthcare) via amine coupling. The immobilization was performed at pH 4.0 using 10 mM sodium acetate buffer. The immobilized TrmD was then blocked with 1 M ethanolamine, pH 8.5. The binding of inhibitors was measured in HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4) at 25 °C. Inhibitors were diluted in HBS-EP buffer and injected at concentrations ranging from 0.1 to 100 μM. The association phase lasted 120 seconds, followed by a 120-second dissociation phase. Regeneration was achieved with 10 mM glycine, pH 2.0. Data were analyzed using Biacore T200 evaluation software (GE Healthcare).

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: HBS-EP buffer (10 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 3 mM EDTA, 0.005% P20, pH 7.4)
